root_cause.text: The for loop in `imx8m_blk_ctrl_remove()` uses `bc->onecell_data.num_domains` as the loop condition instead of comparing `i` against it, causing an infinite loop that accesses `bc->domains[i]` beyond the allocated array, resulting in an out-of-bounds read/write.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff changes the loop condition from `for (i = 0; bc->onecell_data.num_domains; i++)` to `for (i = 0; i < bc->onecell_data.num_domains; i++)`, directly fixing the infinite loop and preventing out-of-range access.
